items.title: Access to Finance for Women in Business Bill
items.description: A Bill to require the Secretary of State to prepare and publish a report on access to finance for women in business; to make provision about the publication of data relating to access to finance for women in business; and for connected purposes.

data.note: Bills where the official Bills API lists Sonia Kumar as a sponsor, verified against each Bill’s sponsor list. Other supporting Members named only in proceedings may not be included. The date is the Bill record’s last update, not its introduction date.
